Intakes = all session names from both, mapped to months from https://www.uow.edu.au/student/dates/ (Autumn=March, Spring=July, Summer=November, Trimester 1/2/3=February/May/August). English table row "IELTS Academic <overall> <bands>". International fees are only a per-session fee and a whole-course fee, so no annual fee is read. Handbook pages (documents.uow.edu.au/handbook/yrYYYY) are archived years and are not read.
